content.title: ABB M3KW-4P Three Phase Electric Motor, 3 kW, 400 V, 1450 rpm, 50 Hz
content.short_description: ABB M3KW-4P three phase electric motor rated 3 kW at 400 V, 50 Hz, with a rated speed of 1450 rpm.
content.long_description:
The ABB M3KW-4P is a three phase electric motor designed for operation on 400 V, 50 Hz supply networks. It delivers a power rating of 3 kW at a rated speed of 1450 rpm, consistent with a 4-pole design operating at standard European mains frequency.

This motor is suited for industrial power and motion applications where a 400 V three phase supply is standard. Confirm supply voltage, frequency, and mechanical mounting requirements against your installation before specifying.

Specification data listed reflects manufacturer-provided electrical and mechanical ratings: frequency, phase configuration, rated voltage, power rating, and rated speed. No additional certifications, enclosure ratings, or frame data have been provided; confirm these details with ABB documentation or your supplier if required for your application.
